caption: The image shows a wooden-framed sofa with a straight back and six legs. The sofa has a rectangular structure with armrests that curve slightly outward and downward. The frame appears to be made of dark brown polished wood, featuring some carved details along the upper rear edge, including a panel with decorative patterns in the center. The upholstered areas, including the seat cushion, the backrest, and the insides of the armrests, are covered in a yellow fabric that has a subtle pattern of small, evenly spaced star shapes. The six legs are straight, round, and tapered with carved rings, each ending with small brass casters at the bottom for mobility. The sofa's seat cushion is separated into three sections by stitched seams. The background of the image is plain and light-colored, providing a clear view of the sofa without any distractions.
